title: Serbian — practical English/ASCII (Đoković → Djokovic)
authority: English-language press and informal 'ošišana latinica' convention (no official status)
description: Gaj's Latin with diacritics removed and Đ written dj, as in English-language media and everyday ASCII writing: Ђ→Dj, Ћ/Ч→C, Џ→Dz, Ш→S, Ж→Z, Љ→Lj, Њ→Nj (Ђоковић → Djokovic).
notes: dj for Ђ/Đ is the English and press convention ('Novak Djokovic'); ICAO MRZ practice uses D instead (see sr_icao). Both should be generated for matching.

Ambiguities: dj also renders Д+Ј (одјек → odjek), c renders Ц, Ћ and Ч, s renders С and Ш, z renders З and Ж, dz renders Џ and Д+З. The output cannot be converted back to Cyrillic without a dictionary.
Other anglicised spellings occur (ch/sh/zh for Ч/Ш/Ж, tj or ch for Ћ, dzh or j for Џ), e.g. in diaspora names; they are not produced here.
Montenegrin С́/З́ → s/z; combining stress marks are dropped.
